<!-- Generated by Ankus.DocGenerator. -->

Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Assembly: `Ankus.Runtime.dll`

Represents PostgreSQL's physical tuple location, <code>tid</code>, as exact block and offset numbers.

```csharp
public readonly struct PgItemPointer : IComparable<PgItemPointer>, IEquatable<PgItemPointer>
```

An invalid offset is distinct from SQL NULL. This managed value is not a native ItemPointerData layout.
Tuple locations can change when PostgreSQL moves or rewrites a row; they are not permanent row identifiers.

Implements: [IComparable&lt;PgItemPointer&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.icomparable-1), [IEquatable&lt;PgItemPointer&gt;](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.iequatable-1)

### PgItemPointer(uint, ushort)

Represents PostgreSQL's physical tuple location, <code>tid</code>, as exact block and offset numbers.

Parameters:

`BlockNumber` — [uint](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint32)

The raw unsigned block number.

`OffsetNumber` — [ushort](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.uint16)

The raw unsigned offset number, including zero and native special values.

An invalid offset is distinct from SQL NULL. This managed value is not a native ItemPointerData layout.
Tuple locations can change when PostgreSQL moves or rewrites a row; they are not permanent row identifiers.
